Definition
[Convex function] 1. appB:B.1-def-1\group Convex Analysis A function $f:\R ^n\to \R $ is convex if \[ (1)\qquad f(\tau x+(1-\tau )y) \leq \tau f(x)+(1-\tau )f(y) \] for all $x,y\in \R ^n$ and $0\leq \tau \leq 1$.
